2026-10-08

# Chief Complaint
No complaints.

# History of Present Illness
Ahmad is a 35 year-old nonhispanic asian male. Patient has a history of dental caries, acute bronchitis (disorder), medication review due (situation), tooth eruption disorder, full-time employment (finding), unemployed (finding), acute viral pharyngitis (disorder), acute infective cystitis (disorder), stress (finding).

# Social History
Patient is single. Patient has never smoked.
 Patient identifies as heterosexual.

Patient comes from a middle socioeconomic background.
 Patient has a high school education.
Patient currently has Medicaid.

# Allergies
No Known Allergies.

# Medications
acetaminophen 325 mg oral tablet; ciprofloxacin 500 mg oral tablet

# Assessment and Plan
Patient is presenting with medication review due (situation), social isolation (finding), reports of violence in the environment (finding). 


## Plan
Patient was given the following immunizations: influenza, split virus, trivalent, pf. 
The following procedures were conducted:
- medication reconciliation (procedure)
- assessment of health and social care needs (procedure)
- assessment of anxiety (procedure)
- depression screening (procedure)
- depression screening (procedure)
- assessment of substance use (procedure)
- screening for drug abuse (procedure)
The following lab reports were completed:
- lipid panel with direct ldl - serum or plasma
- cbc panel - blood by automated count
- generalized anxiety disorder 7 item (gad-7)
- patient health questionnaire 2 item (phq-2) [reported]
- drug abuse screening test-10 [dast-10]

# Chief Complaint

# History of Present Illness
Ahmad is a 35 year-old nonhispanic asian male. Patient has a history of dental caries, acute bronchitis (disorder), medication review due (situation), tooth eruption disorder, full-time employment (finding), unemployed (finding), acute viral pharyngitis (disorder), acute infective cystitis (disorder), stress (finding).

# Social History
Patient is single. Patient has never smoked.
 Patient identifies as heterosexual.

Patient comes from a middle socioeconomic background.
 Patient has a high school education.
Patient currently has Medicaid.

# Allergies
No Known Allergies.

# Medications
acetaminophen 325 mg oral tablet; ciprofloxacin 500 mg oral tablet

# Assessment and Plan
Patient is presenting with medication review due (situation), social isolation (finding), reports of violence in the environment (finding). 


## Plan
Patient was given the following immunizations: influenza, split virus, trivalent, pf.

- medication reconciliation (procedure)
- assessment of health and social care needs (procedure)
- assessment of anxiety (procedure)
- depression screening (procedure)
- depression screening (procedure)
- assessment of substance use (procedure)
- screening for drug abuse (procedure)

- lipid panel with direct ldl - serum or plasma
- cbc panel - blood by automated count
- generalized anxiety disorder 7 item (gad-7)
- patient health questionnaire 2 item (phq-2) [reported]
- drug abuse screening test-10 [dast-10]

# Chief Complaint
No complaints.

# History of Present Illness
Ahmad is a 35 year-old nonhispanic asian male. Patient has a history of dental caries, acute bronchitis (disorder), medication review due (situation), tooth eruption disorder, full-time employment (finding), unemployed (finding), acute viral pharyngitis (disorder), acute infective cystitis (disorder), stress (finding).

# Social History
Patient is single. Patient has never smoked.
 Patient identifies as heterosexual.

Patient comes from a middle socioeconomic background.
 Patient has a high school education.
Patient currently has Medicaid.

# Allergies
No Known Allergies.

# Medications
acetaminophen 325 mg oral tablet; ciprofloxacin 500 mg oral tablet

# Assessment and Plan
Patient is presenting with medication review due (situation), social isolation (finding), reports of violence in the environment (finding). 


## Plan
Patient was given the following immunizations: influenza, split virus, trivalent, pf. 
The following procedures were conducted:
- medication reconciliation (procedure)
- assessment of health and social care needs (procedure)
- assessment of anxiety (procedure)
- depression screening (procedure)
- depression screening (procedure)
- assessment of substance use (procedure)
- screening for drug abuse (procedure)
The following lab reports were completed:
- lipid panel with direct ldl - serum or plasma
- cbc panel - blood by automated count
- generalized anxiety disorder 7 item (gad-7)
- patient health questionnaire 2 item (phq-2) [reported]
- drug abuse screening test-10 [dast-10]

notes.text:
2026-10-17

# Chief Complaint
- Hunger
- Frequent Urination
- Thirst
- Fatigue


# History of Present Illness
Leanne is a 53 year-old nonhispanic white female. Patient has a history of overdose (disorder), medication review due (situation), acute viral pharyngitis (disorder), viral sinusitis (disorder), victim of intimate partner abuse (finding), dental caries, part-time employment (finding), acute bronchitis (disorder), limited social contact (finding), not in labor force (finding), tooth eruption disorder, reports of violence in the environment (finding), full-time employment (finding), gingivitis (disorder), dental caries on pit and fissure surface penetrating into dentin, social isolation (finding), stress (finding).

# Social History
Patient is married. Patient has a documented history of opioid addiction. Patient has never smoked.
 Patient identifies as heterosexual.

Patient comes from a low socioeconomic background.
 Patient has a high school education.
Patient currently has Medicaid.

2026-10-17

# Chief Complaint
- Hunger
- Frequent Urination
- Thirst
- Fatigue


# History of Present Illness
Leanne is a 53 year-old nonhispanic white female. Patient has a history of overdose (disorder), medication review due (situation), acute viral pharyngitis (disorder), viral sinusitis (disorder), victim of intimate partner abuse (finding), dental caries, part-time employment (finding), acute bronchitis (disorder), limited social contact (finding), not in labor force (finding), tooth eruption disorder, reports of violence in the environment (finding), full-time employment (finding), gingivitis (disorder), dental caries on pit and fissure surface penetrating into dentin, social isolation (finding), stress (finding).

# Social History
Patient is married. Patient has a documented history of opioid addiction. Patient has never smoked.
 Patient identifies as heterosexual.

Patient comes from a low socioeconomic background.
 Patient has a high school education.
Patient currently has Medicaid.

# Allergies
